title: Business Development Lead
description:
**About Accrete**
 Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high\-stakes, judgement\-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor.
   

  

 At the core is Accrete’s Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization’s tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high\-stakes decisions — not just answer questions about them.
   

  

 From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a
 **Business Development Lead** 
 to establish and grow Accrete’s presence in the
 **India market** 
 . You will open doors at India’s leading technology companies and global system integrators and build the relationships, partnerships, and pipeline that bring Accrete’s Knowledge Engine and agentic products to enterprise clients.
   

  

 This is a
 **hands\-on, high\-ownership role** 
 . You will act as Accrete’s on\-the\-ground voice in India: shaping our go\-to\-market approach, leveraging your network to secure senior\-level access, and taking deals and partnerships from first conversation to close. You will work closely with Accrete’s leadership, product, and engineering teams to turn market conversations into revenue and lasting strategic relationships.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Market Entry \& Strategy**
* Define and execute Accrete’s India go\-to\-market strategy, including priority accounts, segments, and use cases for the Knowledge Engine and agentic products.
* Map the India enterprise technology landscape \- IT services and consulting firms, technology companies, and large enterprises across industries\- and identify the sectors and use cases where Accrete can create the most impact.
* Track competitors, pricing, buying patterns, and regulatory considerations (such as data residency and privacy requirements) and feed insights back to leadership.
* Build India\-specific sales playbooks, positioning, and collateral in partnership with Accrete’s product and marketing teams.


**Relationships \& Strategic Partnerships**
* Leverage your existing network to secure introductions and build trusted relationships with senior decision\-makers — CXOs, Heads of AI, Digital, Innovation, Delivery, and Alliances \- at leading Indian technology companies.
* Identify, negotiate, and manage strategic partnerships with IT technology/services firms and system integrators, including co\-sell, referral, reseller, and co\-delivery models.
* Represent Accrete at industry events, forums, and ecosystem engagements to build brand awareness and credibility in India.
* Nurture long\-term executive relationships that lead to repeat business and expanded engagements.


**Pipeline \& Deal Ownership**
* Generate, qualify, and grow a healthy enterprise pipeline through outbound outreach, partner channels, and referrals.
* Own the full sales cycle for complex, long\-cycle enterprise deals, from first meeting through proposal, negotiation, and closure.
* Lead pitches, product demos, and executive briefings that clearly articulate Accrete’s value \- context\-grounded, governed, expert AI agents for high\-stakes work.
* Structure commercial proposals and partnership terms, and work with Accrete’s legal and finance teams to close deals.
* Maintain accurate pipeline tracking, forecasting, and reporting in the CRM.


**Collaboration**
* Partner with product and engineering to share market and customer feedback and shape integration and localization priorities.
* Work with solutions and delivery teams to scope and run proofs of concept and pilots that convert into long\-term engagements.
* Coordinate closely with Accrete’s leadership team across time zones to align priorities and share progress.
* Own initiatives from market entry and relationship\-building through deal closure and account expansion.


**What We're Looking For**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; an MBA from a reputed institution is preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in B2B technology business development, enterprise sales, or strategic alliances, with a strong track record in the India market.
* Proven experience closing enterprise deals and/or partnerships with large IT services companies, system integrators, or large enterprises in India.
* An established network of senior decision\-makers at leading Indian technology companies and IT services firms.
* Experience selling complex technical products \- AI/ML, data platforms, cloud, or enterprise software \- to both technical and business stakeholders.


**Skills \& Expertise**
* Strong technical fluency in AI, LLMs, agentic systems, data platforms, APIs, and cloud \- enough to hold credible conversations with CTOs, CDOs, and architects.
* Consultative and solution\-selling skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* Experience navigating partner onboarding, vendor empanelment, and procurement processes at IT services companies and enterprises.
* Strong commercial acumen, including deal structuring, pricing, partnership economics, and contract negotiation.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive\-presence skills; fluent in English.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot.


**Leadership \& Working Style**
* Self\-starter who thrives in ambiguous, early\-stage market environments and can operate independently.
* Strong ownership and accountability for pipeline, revenue, and partnership outcomes.
* Comfortable working across time zones with a globally distributed team.
* High integrity, credibility, and a track record of building trust with senior stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and leadership teams.


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience at an AI, data, or enterprise software company, or in an alliances/partnerships role at a global IT technology/service firm.
* Experience building a market presence in India for a global product or technology company.
* Experience with channel, co\-sell, or marketplace go\-to\-market motions.
* Exposure to regulated industries or selling into environments with strict security, compliance, and data\-sovereignty requirements.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, AI agents, or knowledge graph technologies.


**Cultural Fit \& Values**
**At Accrete, Success Goes Beyond Technical Expertise. We Value**
* Ownership \& Accountability: Drive initiatives to completion with high standards and proactive problem\-solving.
* Transparency \& Communication: Share information openly and give and receive constructive feedback.
* Strategic Thinking \& Problem\-Solving: Analyze challenges critically and develop effective, scalable solutions.
* Collaboration \& Professionalism: Work effectively across teams and contribute to a culture of mutual respect.
* Passion for AI \& Innovation: Stay curious, continuously learn, and push the boundaries of AI.
* Going Beyond the Job Description: Look for opportunities to create impact beyond your immediate responsibilities.


 These principles shape our culture, performance expectations, and growth opportunities.
   

  

**Company Benefits**
* Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary with a performance\-linked variable component, aligned with experience and market standards.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Senior Regional Sales Enablement Manager– APAC
description:
**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

 The Regional Sales Enablement Partner \- APAC (RSEP) is a sales practitioner and enablement leader responsible for the readiness, coaching, and performance of Genesys' APAC field and partner sales organization. Bringing firsthand sales experience to the role, the RSEP builds trusted relationships with regional sales leaders and cross\-functional partners to diagnose performance gaps, then designs and facilitates the coaching, training, and readiness programs that close them.
   

  

 The RSEP is as comfortable in a live coaching conversation with a seller or manager as they are advising senior leadership on regional go\-to\-market priorities. They apply sales methodology expertise, data, and AI\-enabled tools to sharpen judgment and scale impact — and they show up in the field, role\-playing, shadowing calls, reviewing deals, and reinforcing skills in the flow of work. Ultimately, the RSEP is a trusted advisor and an adjunct member of the regional sales leadership team, measured on tangible improvements in seller performance and pipeline outcomes.
   

  

 The RSEP is part of a global enablement team: some programs are built centrally at the global level, and the RSEP is responsible for tailoring and localizing them for APAC's markets, languages, and selling motions, while also feeding regional field insight back into how those global programs are designed. The RSEP is expected to operate fluently in both directions — shaping what gets built globally and making sure it lands regionally.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements:**
* 5\+ years of experience working with Sales team (technology/SaaS strongly preferred), plus 5\+ years in sales enablement, coaching, or sales performance roles, including experience leading enablement for a region or business unit; bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Proven track record coaching and developing sellers and front\-line sales managers — through call/deal reviews, live shadowing, and structured 1:1 coaching — with measurable improvement in skills and results.
* Strong facilitation skills, with confidence leading in\-person and virtual sessions for sellers, managers, and partners across diverse APAC audiences, languages, and time zones.
* Deep fluency in enterprise sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Value Selling, or similar), with the ability to embed it into everyday selling behavior rather than simply introduce it.
* Demonstrated credibility as a trusted advisor to sales leadership and cross\-functional partners (Marketing, RevOps, Product, Partner/Channel), with the executive presence and influence\-without\-authority to shape decisions at senior levels.
* Data\-driven approach — comfortable analyzing pipeline, conversion, and performance data (CRM, Clari, conversation\-intelligence tools) to diagnose gaps and demonstrate enablement impact.
* Experience in a cloud/SaaS company, ideally supporting complex, multi\-persona sales motions across direct and partner/channel teams.
* Experience operating as part of a global, matrixed enablement team — tailoring centrally\-built global programs for regional nuance while feeding field insight back into global program design.
* Comfort leveraging AI\-enabled tools to support coaching preparation, content development, and performance analysis, with a growth mindset toward new AI\-supported approaches to enablement.
* Proficiency with the sales and enablement tech stack (CRM, Seismic, LMS/Lessonly or similar) and standard business tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Self\-motivated, organized, and effective at managing multiple priorities in a fast\-changing, matrixed environment.
* Fluency in languages outside of English a plus, particularly APAC regional languages.


**Key Responsibilities:**
 The Regional Sales Enablement Partner spends the majority of their time directly engaged with sellers, managers, and leaders in the field — coaching, facilitating, and diagnosing performance gaps — while also shaping the regional enablement strategy that those activities feed into. Success in this role is measured by improvement in seller skill, pipeline quality, and win rate.
   

  

**Sales Coaching \& Skill Development**
* Deliver 1:1 and team\-level coaching to sellers and front\-line sales managers to reinforce methodology and close specific skill gaps.
* Facilitate engaging, high\-impact enablement sessions — in person and virtual — including role\-play, negotiation practice, discovery and objection\-handling drills, and certification workshops.
* Support new hire ramp to accelerate time\-to\-productivity and build early confidence.
* Design and deliver skills\-based training aligned to the moments that matter most in a seller's day\-to\-day motion.


**Strategic Advisory \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to APAC sales leadership and cross\-functional partners (Marketing, RevOps, Product, Partner/Channel), proactively surfacing performance gaps and enablement opportunities grounded in data and field insight.
* Build strong relationships with regional stakeholders to pinpoint knowledge and skills gaps, validating findings with data before recommending action.
* Bring firsthand field credibility into planning conversations, informing GTM and enablement priorities with real signal from coaching conversations, deal reviews, and seller feedback.
* Represent APAC's needs and constraints to the global enablement team, providing field\-tested input that shapes how global programs are designed and where regional tailoring will be needed.
* Partner with global enablement peers and instructional designers to localize and adapt global programs for APAC's sellers, partners, and languages.


**Global Program Contribution \& Regional Readiness**
* Tailor and localize globally\-built enablement programs — content, methodology, and delivery format — for APAC's markets, languages, buyer dynamics, and selling motions, ensuring global programs actually change seller behavior in region.
* Own the quarterly readiness plan that brings global programs to APAC field and partner sales, translating global priorities and regional performance data into a prioritized, localized coaching and training calendar.
* Feed regional field insight — from coaching conversations, deal reviews, and seller feedback — back into the global team to inform how future global programs are designed and where global consistency vs. regional flexibility is needed.
* Apply AI\-enabled tools to accelerate content localization, personalize coaching plans, and synthesize field feedback at scale.
* Maintain a consistent through\-line between global enablement strategy and regional execution — flagging where global programs need adaptation and closing that loop with the global team.


**Performance Insights \& Optimization**
* Partner with Sales Ops/RevOps to track how coaching and enablement activity moves pipeline creation, conversion rates, and seller productivity.
* Partner with first line managers to identify skill and performance trends, then convert them into targeted coaching interventions.
* Report enablement and coaching impact to leadership in clear, data\-backed, executive\-ready terms.


**Professionalism \& Team Contribution**
* Exercise sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism in relationships with sellers, partners, and executive stakeholders.
* Contribute to broader Enablement Team initiatives and continuously develop personal coaching and facilitation craft.
* Travel: \~20% (key meetings/events \+ Annual Sales Kickoff).
* Remote, or based near a Genesys office, as required.
* Some early or late meetings required to accommodate our broader global team and varying time zones.


**Working at Genesys**
* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI\-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150\+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible\-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work

* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well\-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
